tutorials.title: 2P Duel
tutorials.description: Two boards. Send Glitch Blocks to your opponent and keep your own stack below the ceiling. The last survivor wins.

tutorials.title: 4P Free-for-all
tutorials.description: Four independent players. Choose a rival to target; the last player alive wins.

tutorials.title: 2v2 Teams
tutorials.description: Two teams of two. Attack the opposing team. A surviving teammate keeps your team in the game; Pulse can rescue a teammate with pending Glitch Blocks.

tutorials.title: 99-player Battle Royale
tutorials.description: Outlast the field in rooms of up to 99 players. This recording uses 98 CPUs and shows ten boards from the full room.

tutorials.title: Swaps, matches & chains
tutorials.description: Swap neighboring panels to match three or more. Falling panels that match again build a chain. Bigger combos and chains send stronger attacks.

tutorials.title: Glitch Break
tutorials.description: Clear next to a slab to fracture it. Glitch Blocks release active tiles from the bottom upward. Your attacks cancel pending Glitch Blocks before sending any excess.

tutorials.title: Pulse — defend & rescue
tutorials.description: Spend 35 Flux to remove one row-equivalent of pending Glitch Blocks. If your queue is empty in teams, Pulse protects a living teammate instead. The example starts with full Flux.

tutorials.title: Shift — make room
tutorials.description: Spend 60 Flux on a stable board to remove its bottom row and lower the stack. Shift earns no score, Flux, attacks, or chain. The example starts with full Flux.

tutorials.title: Surge — power up
tutorials.description: Spend 75 Flux for 8 seconds of stronger attacks and Flux generation. Surge and Overdrive cannot overlap. The example starts with full Flux.

tutorials.title: Overdrive — full charge
tutorials.description: Hold maximum Flux for 3 seconds, then spend it all for 10 seconds of stronger attacks, Flux generation, and faster natural rise. The example demonstrates the full-charge hold before activation.
